note_ko: 헤어 프리셋. 고르면 LoRA 헤어가 통째로 빠지고 이걸로 교체된다. main_en(새 상태), closing_en(남는 가능성을 닫는 문장)은 보통/상세 모두, echo_en(다른 표현 반복)은 상세에서만 쓴다. {color}=LoRA의 hair_color, {p}/{P}=her/Her. 1025: 9종 추가(총 12종).

뱅 + 긴 생머리.desc_ko: 이마를 덮는 앞머리와 어깨 아래로 곧게 내려오는 긴 머리
뱅 + 긴 생머리.main_en: {P} {color} hair falls straight and loose past {p} shoulders, with a full set of soft, straight bangs lying across {p} forehead
뱅 + 긴 생머리.closing_en: nothing is tied up or gathered into a knot, and the bangs cover most of {p} forehead down to just above {p} eyebrows
뱅 + 긴 생머리.echo_en: The bangs sweep evenly over {p} forehead, and the long {color} hair hangs freely down {p} back and over {p} shoulders
뱅 + 긴 생머리.echo2_en: Straight, soft bangs frame {p} brow while the long {color} hair spills smoothly down {p} back

높은 올림머리 (한 덩어리 매듭).desc_ko: 머리 전부를 정수리 위 큰 매듭 하나로 묶은 스타일
높은 올림머리 (한 덩어리 매듭).main_en: ALL of {p} {color} hair is pulled straight up and back off {p} face and wound into one very large, tall, unmistakable knot on the very top of {p} head, clearly visible rising above the outline of {p} head
높은 올림머리 (한 덩어리 매듭).closing_en: {p} ears, neck and shoulders are completely bare of long hair and nothing falls loose past {p} shoulders, only a few short wisps cling to {p} neck and temples
높은 올림머리 (한 덩어리 매듭).echo_en: Seen from any angle, the single tall knot crowns {p} head while {p} neck and shoulders stay clear
높은 올림머리 (한 덩어리 매듭).echo2_en: The whole mass of {color} hair rises into that one tall knot, leaving {p} nape and neck uncovered

낮은 포니테일.desc_ko: 목덜미 높이에서 하나로 묶은 낮은 포니테일
낮은 포니테일.main_en: {P} {color} hair is gathered at the nape of {p} neck into one smooth low ponytail that hangs straight down {p} back
낮은 포니테일.closing_en: {p} forehead and face are fully open and no hair falls loose past {p} shoulders
낮은 포니테일.echo_en: The low ponytail rests between {p} shoulder blades, tied neatly at the nape
낮은 포니테일.echo2_en: A single smooth ponytail falls from the nape of {p} neck, and {p} face stays open

턱선 C컬 단발.desc_ko: 턱선 길이로 자르고 끝이 안쪽으로 둥글게 말리는 단발
턱선 C컬 단발.main_en: {P} {color} hair is cut in a chin-length bob with the ends curling gently inward toward {p} jaw
턱선 C컬 단발.closing_en: the hair ends at {p} jawline and {p} neck is fully visible
턱선 C컬 단발.echo_en: The bob stops at the jawline and every end curves inward in a soft C shape
턱선 C컬 단발.echo2_en: The {color} bob frames {p} face, with the inward-curled ends resting just under {p} chin

허쉬컷 레이어드 미디엄.desc_ko: 쇄골 아래까지 오는, 길이를 층층이 다르게 자른 가벼운 레이어드
허쉬컷 레이어드 미디엄.main_en: {P} {color} hair falls just past {p} collarbones in long loose layers cut at different lengths, with soft face-framing strands beside {p} cheeks
허쉬컷 레이어드 미디엄.closing_en: the layers start near {p} chin and the longest strands end below {p} collarbones
허쉬컷 레이어드 미디엄.echo_en: Light layers of different lengths move around {p} shoulders, with thin strands framing each cheek
허쉬컷 레이어드 미디엄.echo2_en: The {color} hair falls in airy layers from {p} crown to just below {p} collarbones

긴 웨이브 (S컬).desc_ko: 가슴 아래까지 내려오는 부드러운 S자 긴 웨이브
긴 웨이브 (S컬).main_en: {P} {color} hair falls past {p} chest in long soft S-shaped waves, parted slightly off center
긴 웨이브 (S컬).closing_en: the waves begin at {p} ears and roll smoothly down to the middle of {p} chest
긴 웨이브 (S컬).echo_en: Soft S-shaped waves roll down both sides of {p} face to the middle of {p} chest
긴 웨이브 (S컬).echo2_en: The long {color} waves spread over {p} shoulders in smooth, even curves

반묶음 (하프업).desc_ko: 윗머리만 뒤에서 작은 클립으로 묶고 아래는 어깨 아래로 내린 머리
반묶음 (하프업).main_en: the top half of {p} {color} hair is gathered at the back of {p} head with a small clip, while the lower half falls straight past {p} shoulders
반묶음 (하프업).closing_en: two thin strands hang loose beside {p} ears and the lower hair rests on {p} shoulders and back
반묶음 (하프업).echo_en: A small clip holds the upper hair at the back of {p} head while the rest falls down past {p} shoulders
반묶음 (하프업).echo2_en: The upper half of the {color} hair is pulled back and the lower half hangs free along {p} back

양갈래 땋은 머리.desc_ko: 가운데 가르마를 타고 양쪽으로 길게 땋아 어깨 앞으로 내린 머리
양갈래 땋은 머리.main_en: {P} {color} hair is parted down the center and braided into two long braids that hang over the front of {p} shoulders
양갈래 땋은 머리.closing_en: each braid is tied at the end with a thin dark band and reaches {p} chest
양갈래 땋은 머리.echo_en: Two long braids hang on either side of {p} neck from a straight center part
양갈래 땋은 머리.echo2_en: The {color} braids run down from behind {p} ears, one over each shoulder

로우 번 (낮은 올림머리).desc_ko: 목덜미 위에 단정하게 말아 올린 낮은 번, 귀 옆 잔머리 몇 가닥
로우 번 (낮은 올림머리).main_en: {P} {color} hair is gathered into a neat low bun at the nape of {p} neck
로우 번 (낮은 올림머리).closing_en: a few short strands fall beside {p} ears and {p} forehead and neck are fully visible
로우 번 (낮은 올림머리).echo_en: A smooth low bun sits at the nape of {p} neck, held in place at the center
로우 번 (낮은 올림머리).echo2_en: All of the {color} hair is wound into one low bun, leaving {p} ears and neck uncovered

하이 포니테일.desc_ko: 뒤통수 높은 곳에서 하나로 묶어 어깨뼈 아래까지 내려오는 포니테일
하이 포니테일.main_en: {P} {color} hair is pulled up and back and tied high on the back of {p} head into one ponytail that swings down to {p} shoulder blades
하이 포니테일.closing_en: {p} forehead, ears and neck are fully visible and the tail ends between {p} shoulder blades
하이 포니테일.echo_en: The high ponytail starts at the crown of {p} head and hangs behind {p} neck
하이 포니테일.echo2_en: A single {color} ponytail rises from the back of {p} head, with {p} face and neck open

가운데 가르마 긴 생머리.desc_ko: 가운데 가르마를 타고 가슴 중간까지 곧게 내려오는 긴 생머리
가운데 가르마 긴 생머리.main_en: {P} {color} hair is parted in the center and falls straight and smooth to the middle of {p} chest on both sides of {p} face
가운데 가르마 긴 생머리.closing_en: the part runs straight from {p} hairline to the crown and the hair hangs flat and smooth along {p} cheeks
가운데 가르마 긴 생머리.echo_en: The straight center part opens {p} forehead, and the long {color} hair hangs evenly down both shoulders
가운데 가르마 긴 생머리.echo2_en: Smooth straight hair frames both sides of {p} face down to the middle of {p} chest

숏컷 (귀 아래 짧은 머리).desc_ko: 귀를 덮는 길이의 짧은 숏컷, 옆으로 흐르는 앞머리
숏컷 (귀 아래 짧은 머리).main_en: {P} {color} hair is cut short in light layers that end at the middle of {p} ears, with a side-swept fringe over {p} forehead
숏컷 (귀 아래 짧은 머리).closing_en: {p} neck and the back of {p} head are covered only by short hair and nothing reaches {p} shoulders
숏컷 (귀 아래 짧은 머리).echo_en: Short layered hair ends at {p} ears, and the fringe sweeps from the part toward one side
숏컷 (귀 아래 짧은 머리).echo2_en: The cropped {color} hair frames {p} face above {p} jawline, leaving {p} neck clear
